summary: Authorize dispatch to fix up and land PR #1543 (RFC-0054 sign-off): take main's copy of the landed AISDLC-878/879/883 task files, renumber the webhook task AISDLC-918 to AISDLC-925, rebase, lease-push, flip ready, arm

options.description: Dispatch performs steps 1-4 on docs/rfc-0054-sign-off and reports the head
File the fix-up as a backlog task for an executor (blocked: DoR needs RFC-0054 Signed Off, which is what #1543 lands)

body: Extends DEC-0232 (dispatch rebases #1543, branch docs/rfc-0054-sign-off). Since that record, AISDLC-878/879/883 landed on main through their own filing PRs, and #1610 filed a different task under the id AISDLC-918 (tick playbook runs rebase-push), colliding with the webhook task AISDLC-918 ('up owns receiver, forwarder and scheduler; one wake file name; gh webhook forward as the default forwarder') that only exists inside #1543. #1543 is the critical path to running the hierarchy on the webhook: the RFC must read Signed Off on main before the webhook task passes DoR. Work authorized, all mechanical, no subagent: (1) rebase onto origin/main under the DEC-0232 conflict rule, except that backlog/tasks files for AISDLC-878, AISDLC-879 and AISDLC-883 take main's version (883 now lives in backlog/completed via #1608); (2) rename the webhook task file and its id: frontmatter and every in-PR mention (RFC body, README registry if any) from AISDLC-918 to AISDLC-925 (next free id: 924 landed via #1620); (3) npx backlog-drift check, cli-dor-check on the 925 file, pnpm rfc:check; (4) two-call lease push of docs/rfc-0054-sign-off, flip ready, arm via cli-merge-if-eligible when green. A semantic conflict in the RFC body stops the run and comes back to the planner. After landing: AISDLC-925 goes to the head of the queue. Five-step: requirement questioned (the webhook switch is what lets delta/epsilon return and ends polling burn: yes); deleted the duplicate task files from the PR instead of merging them; simplified to one rebase plus one rename; accelerated by not waiting for the operator; automation gap (cli-file id allocation across open PRs) noted, not filed. Class (a): reversible (old head in reflog), docs and task files only, no trust-chain or governance control touched. Operator present and asked for dispatch to do it (2026-10-15 18:55Z).
